text:
Maya S: Heads up — Kairo Health QBR coming up. We saw a sudden token spike last billing period, need a short token-econ readout and renewal risk check before the deck. Can we sync async here? :eyes:
Ethan G: I pulled last 30 days — ~2.7M tokens in March, embeddings ~40% of total. New feature rollout on 3/10 seeded most of the increase. Forecast w/ current velocity -> ~3.2M next month.
Priya R: Quick question — are they on Hosted or Dedicated for prod? That changes commit options.
Maya S: Hosted prod, no reserved commit. They have a sandbox Dedicated trial but not using it for revenue traffic. No SSO yet.
Marcus O: Finance already sent a budget alert email this morning, cc'd renewal. I can run a chargeback calc if someone drops the per-route breakdown.
Ethan G: Sending export now. Query I used: `SELECT route, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM usage WHERE customer='kairo' AND ts>='2026-03-01' GROUP BY route ORDER BY tokens DESC;` Putting CSV in #shared-assets -> <https://redwood.assets/kairo-token-breakout.csv> :file_folder:
Maya S: Got it, thanks. I pasted a quick topline in the QBR notes doc. Highlights: chat/generator is 65% of tokens, embeddings 35%. Top 3 routes: /chat: 1.4M, /embed: 1.0M, /summarize: 0.3M.
Priya R: Renewal escalator risk — they have a 3/31 renewal review scheduled. If we can't show cost controls / action plan, renewal rep may push for discount.
Marcus O: Proposed mitigations: 1) move non-prod to sandbox Dedicated (cap tokens), 2) enable prefix KV caching for summarization routes, 3) recommend 8-bit quant to dev env for embeddings. I can model impact.
Maya S: Action items: - Marcus to run hourly and monthly cost delta model + estimated $ savings (due EOD today). - Ethan to prepare a quick playbook of config changes we can propose (batching, cache TTLs) by tomorrow. - Priya to prep renewal narrative and risks for 3/31. I'll assemble QBR slides after.
Marcus O: Starting calc now. Rough quick math: if embeddings move to quantized runtime w/ 30% token-cost reduction -> savings ≈ $1.2k/mo at current volume. If we add prefix caching on /summarize, latency + cost both improve; need sample hit-rate to finalize.
Ethan G: I'll draft the config snippets for the playbook. Example TTL suggestion: `cache.prefix_ttl: 3600` and batching windows `batch.max_latency_ms: 25` — will test perf impact.
finance-bot: budget-alert: Kairo Health exceeded expected monthly spend by 22% (threshold 15%). Notification sent to finance@redwood.com.
Priya R: For the renewal deck — ask product to sign off on the cost-control roadmap points. @Maya can you pull any customer-reported quality regressions tied to quant/latency so we can preempt objections?
Maya S: Will do. Also tagging support thread ID 4321 for any customer complaints.
Ethan G: Quick note — if they accept a short-term committed discount we can offer staged commit: 3 months with rollback. That helps mitigate churn if cost remains volatile.
Marcus O: My deliverable link -> <https://redwood.ops/models/kairo-cost-model-1734567890.csv>. I'll add scenarios (best/nominal/worst).
Maya S: Perfect. Let's reconvene on thread tomorrow with finalized numbers. Please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done.
Priya R: Aiming to have the renewal narrative draft by EOD tomorrow.
Ethan G: Playbook draft by 09:00 PT tomorrow.
Marcus O: Cost scenarios uploaded, flagged assumptions in the CSV. :rocket:
Maya S: Thanks team. I'll start the QBR slide skeleton now and drop a link when ready.
Priya R: Thx — looping renewal rep into thread: @Lena (renewals)
Lena: added — will watch the numbers and coordinate the call invite.
Maya S: Closing note — priority: mitigate churn risk, show clear $-savings plan in QBR. Keep updates here.
